page.overview:
Who is Four-Armed-Tailor?

Four-Armed-Tailor is a minor character from an alternate universe where humanoid characters have four arms instead of two.

The Four Arms Employee was seen helping a man with a formal suit, he asked what's the purpose for, and the man said he was visiting an old friend.
